principle: Access and hostile-operator themes may become future Admiral operations only when they solve a specific tactical problem. Key collection, generic PMC farming and escalating Raider counters are not progression systems.

en.description: A key is not the objective. Access is. I need proof that a restricted route can be opened, checked and left without turning your pockets into a locksmith's catalogue.
en.started: Use one verified access route for the operation, confirm what is behind it, then extract. Do not bring me a ring of keys; I am interested in the route, not the collection.
en.success: The route is real, usable and no longer theoretical. Keep the key if you have it. The information is what I needed.

ru.description: Ключ — не цель. Цель — доступ. Мне нужно доказательство, что закрытый маршрут можно открыть, проверить и покинуть, не превращая карманы в каталог слесаря.
ru.started: Используй один подтверждённый маршрут доступа, проверь, что находится за ним, и выйди из рейда. Связку ключей мне не неси; меня интересует маршрут, а не коллекция.
ru.success: Маршрут существует, работает и больше не является теорией. Ключ можешь оставить себе. Мне нужна была информация.

objectiveIntent: prove one specific restricted-access route rather than collect keys
survive/extract after using the route so access supports an operation rather than a handover checklist
operations.rewardDoctrine: XP/RUB/standing by default. No permanent key storefront, key container reward or access-capability bypass without explicit overlap and Economy Admiral review.

accessInteraction.requiredProof: exact SPT 4.1.3 condition semantics for one selected restricted-access interaction or a deliberately chosen location proxy

sameRaidCoupling.requiredProof: the selected access interaction/location proxy and survived extraction are required in the same raid

proofGates: prove exact SPT 4.1.3 semantics for the selected restricted-access interaction or deliberately chosen location proxy; reject the interaction requirement if it cannot be represented reliably
prove same-raid coupling between that selected access proof and the already-proven survived-extraction shape
audit overlap with frozen Admiral Access progression plus vanilla/Scorpion/Artem location quests before choosing the route
Economy Admiral approves final numeric and any item rewards

en.description: Labs access is worth nothing if you cannot operate once the doors close behind you. I want one controlled breach of the Raider security pattern and an extraction, not a hundred-man tally.
en.started: Enter Labs under your existing access authority, disrupt a small Raider element, and leave alive. This contract does not grant access and it does not reward staying to farm security teams.
en.success: You proved the clearance can be used under pressure. The security response is not invincible, and more importantly, you knew when the operation was finished.

ru.description: Доступ в Лабораторию ничего не стоит, если после закрытия дверей ты не способен там работать. Мне нужен один контролируемый разрыв схемы охраны Рейдеров и выход, а не счёт на сотню тел.
ru.started: Зайди в Лабораторию по уже имеющемуся допуску, нарушь работу небольшой группы Рейдеров и выйди живым. Этот контракт не выдаёт доступ и не поощряет фарм охраны.
ru.success: Ты доказал, что допуск можно использовать под давлением. Охрана не неуязвима, а главное — ты понял, когда операция закончена.

objectiveIntent: bounded Raider disruption inside The Labs after existing access progression
survive/extract the same operation rather than escalate Raider body counts
operations.rewardDoctrine: Risk-adjusted XP/RUB/standing only by default. No Labs access unlock, keycard faucet, Raider-equipment storefront or capability bypass.

sameRaidCoupling.requiredProof: Raider kill counter and survived extraction are required in the same raid

proofGates: select and validate the exact pinned SPT 4.1.3 The Labs Location value without changing the already-proven Raider target shape
prove same-raid coupling between the bounded Raider counter and the already-proven survived-extraction shape
audit overlap with frozen Admiral Labs clearance and vanilla/Scorpion/Artem Labs objectives
Economy Admiral approves final risk-adjusted numeric and any item rewards

en.description: Another armed contractor is useful only when there is a reason to intercept him. I am not paying for population control. I need a short counter-operator action tied to a route or objective that matters.
en.started: Intercept a small hostile PMC element in the selected operational area and make your extraction. Do not roam the whole region adding bodies to a quota.
en.success: The opposing contractors lost the window they were working. That is enough. A contract should remove a problem, not manufacture a career out of counting corpses.

ru.description: Вооружённый контрактник становится целью только тогда, когда есть причина его перехватить. За зачистку населения я не плачу. Нужна короткая контроперация, привязанная к важному маршруту или задаче.
ru.started: Перехвати небольшую группу враждебных ЧВК в выбранной операционной зоне и выйди из рейда. Не броди по всему району ради пополнения счётчика тел.
ru.success: Противостоящие контрактники потеряли своё рабочее окно. Этого достаточно. Контракт должен устранять проблему, а не создавать профессию из подсчёта трупов.

objectiveIntent: one contextual hostile-PMC intercept tied to a selected operational area
survive/extract after a bounded engagement instead of repeating per-map PMC kill templates
operations.rewardDoctrine: XP/RUB/standing only by default. No PMC gear faucet, dogtag conveyor or weapon-capability unlock; any item reward requires Economy Admiral approval.

sameRaidCoupling.requiredProof: AnyPmc kill counter and survived extraction are required in the same raid

proofGates: select and validate the exact pinned SPT 4.1.3 Location value for the chosen operational area; faction-specific USEC/BEAR aliases remain out of scope until separately proven
prove same-raid coupling between the bounded AnyPmc counter and the already-proven survived-extraction shape
audit overlap with vanilla/Scorpion/Artem PMC objectives and frozen Admiral combat progression before selecting the area
Economy Admiral approves final numeric and any item rewards
